command:
$trialRoot = 'C:\Users\Lvi_P\Documents\Work\CF\平台软著\stategraph-v04-trial-01\project'
$recordPath = Join-Path $trialRoot 'discovery.json'
$discoveryRecord = Get-Content -LiteralPath $recordPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
foreach ($decision in $discoveryRecord.decisions) { if ($decision.id -in @('D04','D05','D06')) { $decision | Add-Member -NotePropertyName asked_in -NotePropertyValue @('A02') -Force } }
$discoveryRecord | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 40 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $recordPath -Encoding utf8
foreach ($name in @('behavior.json','discovery.json','intent.json','acceptance.json')) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $trialRoot $name) -Destination (Join-Path $trialRoot ('review\round-02\' + $name)) -ErrorAction Stop }
$discoveryRecord.decisions | Select-Object id,status,asked_in | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
